milestones.outcome: The pack is imported against the live source with allocated IDs, and the exact composition seams the design changes are recorded.
exit_criteria: Live HEAD, RFC and issue allocations and source drift are recorded without overwriting existing work.
The Accounts adoption, last-runtime branch and quit policy are located in the live tree by file and function.
milestones.boundary: One intake boundary; no application change is implied.

milestones.outcome: Accounts & hosts is the title, the sentence, one card per server and one button, with sign-in inside the card.
exit_criteria: The retired objects are absent from the page and every composed course passes against its new target.
Each configured host renders one card; sign-in, enterprise add, remember and forget work through the existing intents.
milestones.boundary: One Settings-page boundary; Home and the chooser may proceed independently.

milestones.outcome: Home is the bar, then state-ordered rows in collapsible tinted panels, with Group, State headers, account chips and one Filter menu in the strip.
exit_criteria: First-launch, default, long-list, empty, over-a-review and the four grouping states render as accepted with the bar focused on arrival.
Queue and recent rows share one delegate and panel; the surviving preferences live in Filter; view state persists per window; no empty box renders.
milestones.boundary: One Home boundary; the queue projection and preference store are consumed unchanged.

milestones.outcome: Closing a window never presents the chooser, each platform gets its expected exit, and the chooser is a sheet of rows.
exit_criteria: The last-window course proves no presentation, the policy outcome per platform and single-owner reopening.
The sheet component course proves rows, in-place editing, failure notice and the absence of retired controls.
milestones.boundary: One desktop-lifecycle boundary; runtime admission and profile identity are unchanged.

milestones.outcome: Each theme keeps its own colours, and the Appearance page is the theme strip, one-line type rows with a labelled preview, and colours for the theme on screen.
exit_criteria: Migration and per-variant commit, export, import and reset are proven with nothing lost.
The six-tile strip, the eleven rows with glyphs, the preview and the 47-role list are composed in the real Settings window with the retired controls gone.
milestones.boundary: One appearance boundary; RFC-BPR-0006 palettes, roles and theme documents are consumed unchanged.

milestones.outcome: Rendered, keyboard, screen-reader and attended evidence exists for all four surfaces, documentation matches, and formal status is truthful.
exit_criteria: Captures, walks and attended verdicts are bound to revisions; unobserved platforms are recorded as not run.
Documentation gate passes; every closeout row references evidence or a named unresolved criterion.
milestones.boundary: One pack boundary; formal closeout follows canonical order and never falsifies a status.
